title: Poultry Farm (DS)
wikitext:
The '''Poultry Farm''' is a store in ''[[Harvest Moon DS]]'' and ''[[Harvest Moon DS: Cute]]''

The Poultry Farm can be reached via telephone and is open from 11am until 4pm every day except for Sundays and holidays. [[Popuri (DS)|Popuri]] sells chickens, ducks, feed and accessories.
